title: Social Media Marketing
short: A clearer plan for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and TikTok, with content that sounds like your business and gives people a reason to pay attention.
intro: Social media marketing for businesses that want a feed that keeps going. We plan content around what your business is doing, what your audience needs to know and what you want the brand to be known for, then make it: the captions, the photos, the reels. The goal is a social presence that looks and sounds like the business behind it.
includes: Content planning and calendar direction.
Copywriting for captions, posts and campaigns, written in your brand’s voice.
Photography, reels and short-form video, planned around your products and your people.
Behind-the-scenes content that gives your audience something real to see.
Email newsletters and campaigns that keep your customers up to date.
Publishing and ongoing channel support where agreed.
fit: Businesses that know they should post more, but never have the time to plan, shoot and write it.
meta: Social media marketing for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and TikTok: content plans, captions, photos and reels that sound and look like your business.
keyline: Plans, captions, reels and shoots that look like you.

how.text: We learn what you sell, who buys it and what you want to be known for. That shapes everything we post.
A simple content plan first, then the captions, photos and reels that go with it.
Posts go out, we watch what people respond to, and we adjust the plan with you.

title: Web Design
short: A new website, or a redesign of the one you have, that looks like your brand and makes it easy for people to get in touch.
intro: Your website is where everything else lands: the social post, the Google search, the recommendation from a friend. It should show people quickly what you do, whether it is for them and how to take the next step. We design sites that feel like your brand and work properly on a phone.
includes: Page structure and layout planned around what your visitors need to find.
Design that follows your brand, built to work on phones, tablets and desktops.
Copywriting for every page, so headings and calls to action say something specific.
Contact forms and WhatsApp links that make getting in touch easy.
Launch setup and handover, with the scope confirmed before work starts.
fit: Businesses that need a new site, or a redesign of a site that no longer matches how good the business is.
meta: Web design from Digital Mom: new websites and website redesigns, built to work on every screen and make it easy for customers to get in touch.
keyline: A site that matches how good the business is.

title: SEO
short: Make it easier for the right people to find you when they search, with clear pages and sound technical foundations.
intro: When someone searches for what you do, your business should be easy to find and easy to understand. SEO is the work behind that: what your pages say, how they are built and how search engines read them. We start with what your customers actually search for, then fix the pages, structure and details that stand in the way.
includes: Keyword and search-intent research around what your customers look for.
On-page work: page titles, headings, descriptions and copy.
Technical checks on structure, speed, mobile use and indexing.
Local search support, including your Google Business Profile where relevant.
Content planning for search, and reporting on the data available.
fit: Businesses that want to be found by people already searching for what they do.
meta: SEO from Digital Mom: search research, on-page and technical improvements and local search support to help the right customers find you.
keyline: Be easy to find when people go looking.

how.text: We research the words and questions your customers type into Google when they need what you do.
Page titles, headings and copy are written so each page clearly answers a search.
We check speed, mobile use and how search engines read your site, then fix the problems we find.
We look at the data available, see what is working and change the plan. SEO takes time, and we never promise rankings.

photo_alt: The word Google spelled out in coloured sweets on a white table, beside a laptop open on a Google search.
